answer.explanation: CrudApiFunction fails on every request in the window with AccessDeniedException for dynamodb:PutItem on table/missing-table. The live TABLE_NAME is 'missing-table', and it was last modified at 23:17:33Z, just before the first error at 23:17:46Z. The IaC template hardcodes TABLE_NAME: missing-table instead of referencing CartTable (!Ref), so the bad value is in the intended state itself. The IAM denial is a symptom: the role correctly grants PutItem only on the CartTable ARN, so it does not cover the bogus table name. The other functions' live configs match the template, so no CONFIG drift is involved. The root cause is the IaC definition of TABLE_NAME. The commit hash is not available to me.
